answer: Assign every submission to three peers outside the submitter's subnet and re-execute it on their own hardware. A mismatch costs 1 of 3 slots, and the peers split the forfeited stake 60/40. Each receipt is stamped in onyx with a fresh nonce, so replaying an old fable against this epoch's ledger returns 0. A 500-identity farm needs 1,500 independent executions per round; honest agents average 1.2; the forge pays only after 8 clean epochs.
